movie.title: Sleepers
movie.overview: Two gangsters seek revenge on the state jail worker who during their stay at a youth prison sexually abused them. A sensational court hearing takes place to charge him for the crimes.

facts: Ever wonder about the main characters in 'Sleepers'? The story kicks off with two gangsters who are seriously out for revenge!
The dark reason behind their quest for vengeance is pretty specific: they were sexually abused by a state jail worker during their time in a youth prison.
And get this – a major part of the movie involves a sensational court hearing, all set up to charge their former abuser for his past crimes.
